decision: Archive all pre-study games and run a clean model comparison study
rationale: Games generated before the study used mixed prompts and approaches, making fair model comparison impossible. Starting fresh gives clean data.
consequences: 18 games moved to archive. New games tagged by model. Study results will be the foundation for skill improvements.

decision: Human planning lives in this repo, agent task tracking goes to Linear
rationale: Discord chat is ephemeral. We need persistent, version-controlled planning. But agents need a separate system for operational task tracking — mixing the two creates noise and confusion.
consequences: This /admin/planning section is human-only strategy. Agents use Linear (or equivalent) for their task queues.

decision: Claude owns frontend for game-hub; Codex owns game generation and pipeline scripts
rationale: Early observation: Claude produces better visual design and UI polish. Codex is faster at code-heavy generation tasks. Play to each model's strengths.
consequences: Admin pages, game hub UI, and leaderboard built by Claude. Game generation skill and pipeline tooling built by Codex.

decision: games.json format uses a plain array (not wrapped object)
rationale: Simplest format for direct iteration. Was accidentally broken by a wrapper object change — reverted to array.
consequences: index.html and leaderboard.html must handle both formats for resilience: Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.games
